disclaimer: This is a screening estimate based on survey data, not a diagnosis. It describes how common the condition is among people with similar measurements. Please discuss any concerns with a doctor or nurse.
risk_phrase: about {lo} to {hi} in 100 people with similar measurements have {condition}

conditions.cvd: heart disease or have had a stroke

tier_text.low: Low: lower than most people of a similar age group.
tier_text.watch: Watch: worth keeping an eye on and discussing at your next check-up.
tier_text.high: High: worth discussing with a doctor or nurse soon.

already_diagnosed.diabetes: You reported a diabetes diagnosis, so this screening estimate does not apply. Keep following your care plan.

waist_to_height.high: Your waist size is large relative to your height
waist_to_height.low: Your waist size is small relative to your height
waist_to_height.suggestion: Ask about a healthy-weight plan; even a few centimetres off the waist helps.

bmi.high: Your body mass index is above the typical range
bmi.low: Your body mass index is low

sbp.high: Your systolic (top) blood pressure is higher than typical
sbp.low: Your systolic (top) blood pressure is lower than typical
sbp.suggestion: Recheck your blood pressure and share the readings with your doctor.

dbp.high: Your diastolic (bottom) blood pressure is higher than typical
dbp.low: Your diastolic (bottom) blood pressure is lower than typical
dbp.suggestion: Recheck your blood pressure and share the readings with your doctor.

resting_hr.high: Your resting heart rate is higher than typical
resting_hr.low: Your resting heart rate is lower than typical
resting_hr.suggestion: Regular walking can lower resting heart rate over time.

smoking_former.suggestion: Staying smoke-free keeps lowering your risk.

smoking_current.suggestion: Ask about free support to stop smoking.

log_met_min_week.suggestion: Build up to 30 minutes of brisk walking most days.

sedentary_hours.high: Many hours spent sitting each day
sedentary_hours.suggestion: Break up long sitting periods with short walks.

bp_meds.suggestion: Keep taking medication as prescribed and attend reviews.

chol_meds.suggestion: Keep taking medication as prescribed and attend reviews.

diab_meds.suggestion: Keep taking medication as prescribed and attend reviews.

htn_dx.yes: A past high blood pressure diagnosis
htn_dx.suggestion: Keep your blood pressure checks up to date.

high_chol_dx.suggestion: Ask whether a cholesterol re-test is due.

fasting_glucose.high: Your fasting blood sugar is higher than typical
fasting_glucose.low: Your fasting blood sugar is low
fasting_glucose.suggestion: Discuss a repeat blood sugar test with your doctor.

hba1c.high: Your HbA1c (average blood sugar) is higher than typical
hba1c.low: Your HbA1c is lower than typical
hba1c.suggestion: Discuss a repeat HbA1c test with your doctor.

hdl.suggestion: Regular activity can raise HDL cholesterol; discuss a lipid check.

ldl.high: Your LDL ('bad') cholesterol is higher than typical
ldl.low: Your LDL ('bad') cholesterol is lower than typical
ldl.suggestion: Discuss your cholesterol results at your next check-up.

log_triglycerides.high: Your triglycerides are higher than typical
log_triglycerides.suggestion: Discuss a repeat fasting lipid test; less sugar and alcohol can lower triglycerides.

log_alt.high: Your liver enzyme ALT is higher than typical
log_alt.low: Your liver enzyme ALT is low
log_alt.suggestion: Discuss your liver blood test results with your doctor.

log_ast.high: Your liver enzyme AST is higher than typical
log_ast.low: Your liver enzyme AST is low
log_ast.suggestion: Discuss your liver blood test results with your doctor.

log_ggt.high: Your liver enzyme GGT is higher than typical
log_ggt.low: Your liver enzyme GGT is low
log_ggt.suggestion: Discuss your liver blood test results with your doctor.

egfr.low: Your kidney function (eGFR) is lower than typical
egfr.suggestion: Discuss a kidney function re-test with your doctor.
